basics.name: Zhengyang Qi
basics.label: Senior Research Scientist
basics.summary: Post-training and evaluation researcher building feedback systems, agentic RL infrastructure, rubrics, and environments for complex AI systems.

work.name: Snorkel AI
work.summary: Post-training frontier language models and building evaluation environments for agentic systems.
highlights: Led GRPO post-training for LLM-based terminal coding agents on internal Terminal Bench tasks, scaled synthetic mid-training trajectory generation, and improved task success 2.2x from 5.6% to 13.4% on Qwen-3 models.
Built agentic RL systems from scratch with verl, Ray-based training frameworks, AWS and Kubernetes cluster management, and distributed rollout infrastructure spanning 64 H200 GPUs.

Designed and built 50+ professional computer-use tasks and environments for visual agents, covering complex interface grounding, long-context behavior, and test-time compute in circuit design workflows.
Designed rubric-based and preference-based human annotation pipelines for medical conversational agents and prototyped 40k+ context synthetic data generation via EHR simulation.

work.name: Scale AI
work.summary: Post-trained LLM judges and built scalable oversight systems for human-AI data pipelines.
highlights: Led post-training for LLM judge models with SFT and GRPO, curated 60k+ frontier-capability datasets, and delivered a production reward judge model that outperformed GPT-4o in reward and preference alignment.
Built production auto-evaluation and scalable oversight systems with multi-agent debate, context management, and reliable A/B-tested metrics, reducing human labeling reliance by up to 60%.
Developed automated quality control agents for RLHF rubric pipelines via RAG, tool use, and multi-agent debate, consistently improving over baseline heuristics.

work.name: Intuit
work.summary: Built ML microservices for tax form understanding and automation.
highlights: Designed and implemented scalable ML microservices to identify redundant data across 1k+ variations of tax forms for 42M users, integrating GPT-3.5, XGBoost, and Spring Boot.

work.name: Intuit
work.summary: Built multimodal inference pipelines and optimized large-scale image processing systems.
highlights: Constructed an image captioning model with GPT-2/3 and CLIP, built a Spark pipeline for 70k+ images, reduced model size by 68%, and cut inference latency by 82% with CUDA and PyTorch FSDP.

work.name: Kiwi
work.summary: Built recommendation and data infrastructure for a retail startup.
highlights: Led a three-engineer team building a multimodal recommender system across 18 retailers, automated acquisition of 100k+ items, and achieved a 64% improvement over baseline on entity matching with XGBoost and LightGBM.
